series: CPI-U all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted
source: Archived August 2026 CPI news release, Table 1
verification_method: Both observation levels are published in the BLS archived August 2026 CPI release dated September 11, 2026; the release predates the October 5, 2026 decision date.
adjustment_method: Not seasonally adjusted CPI-U; year-over-year comparison of same-month indexes.
transformations: Inflation = 334.980 / 323.976 - 1. CPI + 4% target uses arithmetic addition, matching the project mandate convention.
note: This is point-in-time verified from the BLS release available on the decision date; it is not represented as an ALFRED API vintage.
